name: The Young household at 1812 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_young_lawrence_a

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1812 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1812 Mr. & Mrs. Lawrence A. Young.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1812, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The seven live-in staff and two children it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census (T624 roll 241, ED 166 and 167) was read for this card's children: the children it lists, and those the Blue Book lists at the number from 1890 to 1911, are on the card with the years each lived here, whether or not they were at home in 1904. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Lawrence A. Young
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Lawrence A. Young here as head, born May 1870, in Kentucky, married, lawyer (ED 40, sheet 5A, line 33, leaf n802).

born.note: Biographical date from the cited period publication(s). The earlier census transcription on this card is retained as a separate reading; where it disagrees, this figure uses the independently published biographical date. The publication date is not the date the photograph was taken.

portrait.caption: Lawrence A. Young, undated photograph published in Men of Illinois (1902), p. 203.
portrait.why: Identified by the printed caption and checked against the household record. The monochrome photograph does not establish skin, eye or clothing colours.

persons.name: Lawrence R. Young

born.note: The 1910 census gives age 7 on 15 April 1910, so born about 1902-1903.

persons.note: The Youngs' third child: the 1910 census lists him at 1812 aged 7, with his brother Henry W. and sister Alice, and their mother as having borne three children, all living (ED 166, sheet 1A, lines 41-45). Born about 1902-03 to a family listed here from the 1897 edition to 1914, he was very likely a baby in the house on 1 July 1904; that is inferred from his age, not recorded.
